flags.reason: misreads-source: The guide says the opposite: "Compact defaults to the 88 × 54 picture where Figma shows a 42 px Avatar". The evidence agrees ("Compact defaults to the 88 × 54 image"). The item repeats the package JSDoc's claim that a 42 px Avatar renders by default, which the guide reports as a discrepancy.

misreads-source: The guide says "an empty headline, description, or footerSubtitle shows its placeholder word", and the evidence's Limits say "Don't imply ... that footer lines can be hidden one by one". The added "'' or null hides the line" contradicts this.
misreads-source: Same as headline: the guide says an empty description "shows its placeholder word", so "'' or null hides the line" contradicts it and the evidence's Limits.
misreads-source: Same as headline: the guide says an empty footerSubtitle "shows its placeholder word", so "'' or null hides the line" contradicts it and the evidence's Limits.

notes: Two of the cited type facts disagree with the guide and the evidence. /facts/props/0 (compact renders a 42 px Avatar) and /facts/props/16–18 ('' or null hides the line) come from the package's JSDoc. The guide and evidence record both as wrong: the evidence notes 'JSDoc says both "an Avatar by default" and "an Image"', and that placeholders come back, tracked in ticket #364. The type facts themselves are outside this review's scope, but they need correcting, or overriding with evidence, so later extractions don't repeat them. A minor point, not flagged: in /examples/1, footerSubtitle holds 'Joining fee', while the guide's content rule puts the fee label in headline. In compact the name takes headline, so this is a reasonable adaptation.
